tasks.prompt: An escaped-text parser loses input when its normal-content parser consumes a prefix and then returns a recoverable failure. For example, a normal parser that accepts alphabetic text only when followed by '!' should leave the input consisting of 'a', a backslash, 'n', and ';' untouched when that terminator is missing; the escape layer should stop with an empty result and the full remainder. Instead, it consumes the prefix and escape. Fix this for recognition and transformation on both complete and partial streams. Preserve successful parsing, committed failures, and incomplete-input behavior. Add regression coverage.

tasks.prompt:
Parsing an unfinished link or image label can change how later inline code is rendered. For example, '[foo `bar` baz`' should render as '

[foo bar baz`

\n', and the corresponding unfinished image case should preserve its code span too. Also keep a code span from consuming a closing marker beyond the current label boundary: '[`](``)' should remain a link whose visible label is a literal backtick. Correct these inconsistent inline results while preserving normal code spans, link precedence, different backtick-run lengths and ordinary Markdown behavior. Add regression tests.

Add regression tests; avoid changing the public renderer contract.

tasks.prompt: Valid deeply nested stylesheets fail with 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' during normal AST operations. A stylesheet consisting of 'a{' repeated 6000 times, then 'color:red', then 6000 closing braces should round-trip through parsing/stringification, cloning and the toJSON/fromJSON APIs, and walking it should visit all 6001 nodes. A normal declaration plugin must also be able to change the innermost value without overflowing. Fix the supported traversal paths consistently while preserving ordinary node order, metadata, custom properties with toJSON methods, subclass overrides and visitor revisit semantics. Add regression coverage; changing global runtime stack limits is not an acceptable repair.
